results.text: CYP3A mediates drug-drug interactions between atorvastatin and omeprazole: Evidence from in vitro and in vivo studies. Improving CYP2C19 phenotyping using stereoselective omeprazole and 5-hydroxy-omeprazole metabolic ratios. Omeprazole (OME) is a CYP2C19 phenotyping probe, marketed as a racemic (S)/(R) mixture or as an S-enantiomer. Both CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 enzymes mediate (R)-OME hydroxylation to (R)-5-hydroxyomeprazole, while (S)-OME is exclusively hydroxylated via CYP2C19.
